title: Act: Subscribe App to the objectClick event from Phaser
summary: Add a phaserToReact objectClick subscription that sets selectedId.
description: Edit game/frontend/src/App.tsx to subscribe to phaserToReact objectClick and select that object, unsubscribing on unmount.
acceptance_criteria: Given objectClick is emitted with an id, when App is mounted, then selectedId becomes that id.
Given App unmounts, when cleanup runs, then the subscription is removed.

preserve: Existing loadRound effect and early-return ordering

technical_constraints: Hook must be declared before the `if (!begun)` early return
definition_of_done: useEffect returns the unsubscribe function from phaserToReact.on

steps.action: Add an import of phaserToReact from './phaser/events' next to the existing runtime imports.
Insert a useEffect after the loadRound effect that calls phaserToReact.on('objectClick', ({ id }) => setSelectedId(id)) and returns the unsubscribe function, with an empty dependency array.
steps.expected: Emitting objectClick sets selectedId so ActionMenu opens; unmount removes the listener.
